name: Ashwalker
text: Burning ground does not harm you. Fight inside your own fires.

name: Shatterhand
text: Heavy attacks against frozen enemies shatter the ice and hurt everything nearby.

name: Smoke-Step
text: Dodging leaves a puff of steam; enemies lose sight of you inside it.

name: Flask-Wright
text: Thrown flasks splash twice as wide.

name: Echo-Eater
text: Harvesting an echo heals you for 12.

name: Cold Blood
text: Below 35% health your hits chill — and chilled wet things freeze.

name: Steady Mind
text: You gain 40% less Fray from casting.

name: Fray Conduit
text: Above 50 Fray your spells deal double damage instead of +50%. Live near the rupture.

name: Heavy Hand
text: Heavy attacks always stagger and hurl targets back — into fire, water or each other.

name: Scavenger's Sense
text: Creatures drop loot more often; echoes linger twice as long.
